ask.description:
Chat with the assistant. Ask about the weather or the time somewhere, or ask it to run
something in its scratch workspace; it may ask you a question back. Sent while it is
working, the message steers it instead: the text reaches the model with the next tool
result.

TextMessage.description: Free-form natural-language text from the user (the input to a plain chat handler).
TextMessage.title: TextMessage

TextReply.description: A free-form natural-language reply (the output of a plain chat handler).
TextReply.title: TextReply
